title: Verdant GB is out: a Game Boy tileset in the four GB Studio shades, overworld, town and dungeon
body:
Verdant GB is out: a 16x16 Game Boy style tileset drawn only in the four GB Studio shades, for GB Studio, Tiled, Godot 4, RPG Maker MZ and Unity. Three environments in one download, 569 tiles. $7.99. csaf.itch.io/verdant-gb

Built for the tile budget. A GB Studio background can hold at most 192 unique 8x8 tiles. Every autotile set here is drawn from 13 distinct 8x8 tiles, because each quarter of a tile depends only on its own neighbours and every texture repeats every 8 pixels. The three sample scenes count 140, 153 and 99 unique tiles of 192, counted on the shipped PNGs; GB Studio itself was not run on them.

The Overworld (222 tiles): grass, a dirt path, a pond with a shore line, tall grass and a hill with a rock face, trees, a boulder, a picket fence and a cave mouth. The Town (183 tiles): a cobbled square with lawns, flowerbeds and a road with a kerb, houses, a shop, a fountain, a market stall and a well. The Dungeon (164 tiles): brick walls, a bottomless pit, a carpet runner, chests, braziers, statues, a push block, floor switches, spikes and stairs.

10 complete 47 shape autotile sets and 37 objects. The scenes ship as GB Studio backgrounds, the sets as Tiled Wang sets, a Godot TileSet, an RPG Maker MZ A2 page and Unity RuleTile brushes.

Every tile is drawn by our own procedural pixel art engine, which is AI written software. No image model draws any tile, and the listing carries the Generative AI tag. The cover and every gallery image are made from the pack's own tiles.
